lead.why: Abstract: compound 3 was more cytotoxic and apoptotic than 5, bound AChE better by docking and inhibited AChE more effectively; conclusion: '3, which was synthesized for the first time ... seems to have potential in both cancer and Alzheimer's disease treatment'.

reactions.conditions: Sonogashira: PdCl2(PPh3)2 (3 mol%), CuI (6 mol%), Et3N/THF 1:1, argon, 80 C, 12 h; Celite filtration, silica chromatography; 69 % (section 2.1.1). Section 3.1 says room temperature for 12 h instead of 80 C.
reactions.source: Section 2.1.1 and 3.1 (Fig. 1) of the article; no SI used

notes: Single step. The paper does not say the two starting materials are purchased but uses them without preparation. Regiochemistry (alkynylation at C2 of 2,3-dibromothiophene) follows the printed product name. Temperature inconsistency between experimental (80 C) and results text (room temperature). Compound 5 (the second compound, 2 steps via 3) is not the lead.
